theorem typeII_637 {α x Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hx : 0 < x) {U V : ℕ} (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (hV : (2000000 : ℝ) ≤ V) (hVU : (V : ℝ) ≤ x / U) (hQ : 3.5 * (x / U) ≤ Q)
    (hqV : 2 * rexp 1 * q ≤ V) :
    ‖typeII α x U V‖ ≤
      x / √(2 * Nat.totient q) * √((Real.log (x / (U * V)) + Real.log (2 * q) *
        (Real.log (Real.log (x / U / (2 * q))) - Real.log (Real.log (V / (2 * q))))) *
        (0.60428 * Real.log (x / (U * V)) + 0.0924 + 8 * zeta3 * √(x / V) / U)) +
      4 * √(kap1 x U V * q * x / (2 * Nat.totient q)) * (2 * √(x / U) + √(Real.log (2 * q)) *
        (2 * rexp 1 * √(2 * q) + 4 * √(x / U / Real.log (x / U / (2 * q))))) +
      8 * 1.4262 * x * √(kap1 x U V * (1 / 2 + 1 / U)) / √V :=

note: Lean now assumes V ≥ 2·10⁶, the chapter's standing assumption, and Q ≥ 3.5x/U, which Prop 5.2.4 needs but Ch. 6 does not list. Erratum: The main term of (6.37) inherits the (5.36) error: its second factor needs + 4E(x/UV), which is 0.0922 for x/UV >= 16, and the first choice reaches x/UV = 2 sqrt(q delta_0) up to 2828 (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_6_37.py`).
